title: 第12章 金光术

第12章 金光术
李长湖第六次从入定中惊醒，咬着牙重新盘膝而坐，平复起心境来。
“太难。”
修炼了三月有余，他仅仅凝聚几缕月华，项平已经尝试凝聚玄景轮，通崖也凝聚七十余缕月华，唯独他李长湖还在个位数打转。
相比起两个弟弟修炼的轻松写意，李长湖引导灵气跨越十二重楼都吃力无比，就连气海穴中的符种也无精打采，黯淡无光。
甚至炼化月华时别说白天，月色稍微不好的夜里他连月华都感知不到了，如今这几缕月华还是依靠法鉴来凝聚的。
“唉。”
李长湖已经自知在修仙一道上毫无天份，每每轮到他来借助法鉴修炼时都愧疚无比，自觉挡了弟弟们的道途。
第七次从入定中惊醒，李长湖神色黯淡，看了看身旁的李通崖和李项平，他悄悄起身，向门外走去。
李木田正在后院弯着腰打磨着长刀。
“我恐非修仙那块料。”李长湖有些羞愧地回答。
“也罢。”
“当～”
“怎么了，屏儿。”李长湖见了妻子，眉眼柔和了不少，望着她轻轻问道。
任屏儿容貌端庄大气，眉眼带着点喜色，低低地道：
————
出乎意料，李项平很轻松地抱起了这青石，甚至由于用力过猛仰头狠狠地退了几步。
“是。”李长湖重重一点头，急冲冲地往正院去了。
“步入胎息，寿数一百二十载，法力流通窍脉，身轻、力大、耳聪、目明，掐诀施法，非同俗类。”
《金光术》

亮色的火星子一闪而过，青石表面多了一道不深不浅的刀痕，倒是足足后退了一掌之距，在地面上带出淡白色的摩擦划痕。
“你小子说什么？”
李木田思忖了一会儿，神色缓和了许多，摇摇头说：
“明日就算了，你去筹备项平婚礼的事，不要太张扬，请上些亲戚就低调办了。”
李项平掐了个法诀，缓缓从入定中醒来。
李项平回想起《太阴吐纳养轮经》上的描述，不禁失笑，抱着青石进了后院。
“还能骗你不成，婆婆都看过了，是有了。”任屏儿羞涩地点点头嗔道。
“好法术！”
“什么？”李长湖惊得不轻，脑海中的压抑烦躁不翼而飞，他脸色微红，兴奋地反问道：
“真的有了？”
那《太阴吐纳养轮经》念不得也写不得，但这伴生的法诀却可以口授笔录，李通崖几人便誊抄了自己得到的法术，相互传看。
“屏儿有了！”李长湖像个孩子般傻乐着，笑着道。
“引气练华，九月玄景，呼吸吐纳，三月承明，称之为根骨上佳。”李项平坐在二哥身边，念着养轮经中的描述，开口对李通崖说：
“接助了外物，这玄景的标准便算不得了，倒是这三月承明，大可借来比比。”
李长湖连连点头，拉着任屏儿坐下，仔细嘘寒问暖起来。
《金光术》并不难，李项平读罢对照了两个晚上，便将诀窍通通领悟在心了。
“父亲。”
眼前这卷《金光术》便是李尺泾所得法术，李项平前几夜便修成了玄景轮，就借了这法术来练。
“那你便不修了？”李木田抬起头，冷冷地望着他。
“父亲，父亲！屏儿有了！”

胎息六轮分别唤作玄景、承明、周行、青元、玉京、灵初，其中玄景、周行、玉京三轮唤作胎息三关，尤为艰难。
“泾儿不到一月便入了玄景，虽说有法鉴相助，但也太过惊人。”李通崖摇了摇头。
“当锵…”
李长湖哈哈一笑，欣喜不已，连忙喊着走向后院。
“金光术！”
“好！好。”
他伸手将身前立着的木简拿起，松开绑着的布条，“哗啦”一声将其展开。
谁知这才进了正院，便见着妻子任氏正坐在院中，一边缝制衣服，一边同田芸聊着天。女眷入不得后院祠堂，只好在此处等着。
李长湖坚定了神色，开口道：
田芸见李长湖出来，两夫妻似有话说，便笑着寻了个借口，回田家去了。
挥手散去法术，李项平出了院门，几个哥哥都在盘膝修行，他在门口寻了块青石，双手抱住，低声喝道：
“起！”
“我有了。”
只听一阵铁器碰撞声，李木田当即舍了刀，匆匆地走到了正院，神色激动地问道：
“非是不修。”李长湖早有了腹稿，望着父亲解释道：
“我的天赋远远不如通崖与项平，更不用说泾儿了，借助法鉴才勉强修炼，白日里不如替父亲整理家业，去田上转一转，也不至于让人起了疑心。”
他将青石摆正，后退三丈，施法掐诀，一道金光从掌中跃出，直直地劈斩在青石上。
此乃攻杀护道之术，掐诀施法便可凝聚一道金芒，锋利异常。
李尺泾几人接助法鉴轻易突破了胎息之门，此后的承明轮已无捷径可走，只得乖乖吐纳灵气，凝聚胎息。
他左手一翻，一道流光溢彩的金芒从掌心处浮现而出。

却是李通崖早已从入定中醒来，望着李项平笑道：
“泾儿得了这法术最是好用，前几天他施法斩歪了后院的假山，我都没敢告诉父亲。”
“长湖。”
他右手握着刀背，左手拇指与食指捏住刀身，两手稳稳地持着刀，在砺石上反复打磨。
皎洁的月光下，卷首的几个大字赫然在目：
这金芒可附在刀剑攻杀敌人，亦可甩出击掷，威力尤为可观。
“论修行，我们真真不如泾儿。”李项平撇了撇嘴，将青石摆正，估摸了下自己体内的法力，大概还可以施法四到五次。
李木田开怀大笑，拍了拍红着脸的任屏儿，朗声对李长湖道：
“我去请先生，你好生看着她。”
“何事？”李木田头也不抬，淡淡地说。
“不错。”李通崖微微点头，又低声道：
“大哥他……”
“大哥恐怕比你我还要差些。”李项平有些闷闷地开口，静静地望着夜幕下的大黎山。
“我再调息几日，便可尝试凝聚玄景轮，若是功成，法鉴便可全供大哥修炼。”李通崖思忖道。
望着大黎山的李项平却是一眯眼，骤然站起，望着后山厉声道：
“贼子好胆！”
(本章完)

Chapter 12 Golden Light Technique
Li Changhu woke up from his trance for the sixth time. He gritted his teeth and sat cross-legged again to calm down.
"Too difficult."
After practicing for more than three months, he could only condense a few rays of moonlight. Xiang Ping had already tried to condense the Xuanjing Wheel. Tongya had also condensed more than 70 rays of moonlight. Only he, Li Changhu, was still spinning in single digits.
Compared with the ease and ease with which his two younger brothers practiced, Li Changhu found it extremely difficult to guide his spiritual energy across the twelve-story building. Even the talismans in the Qi Sea Cave were listless and dull.
Even when he was refining the moonlight, let alone during the day, he couldn't even feel the moonlight at night when the moonlight was a little bad. Now these few rays of moonlight still rely on the Dharma Jian to condense them.
"Alas."
Li Changhu already knew that he had no talent in cultivating immortals. Every time it was his turn to practice with the help of Dharma Jian, he felt extremely guilty and consciously blocked the path of his brothers.
Awakening from trance for the seventh time, Li Changhu looked gloomy. He looked at Li Tongya and Li Xiangping beside him. He quietly got up and walked out the door.
Li Mutian was bending over and polishing a long knife in the backyard.
"I'm afraid I'm not a cultivator." Li Changhu replied with some shame.
"That's fine."
"Dang~"
"What's wrong, Ping'er?" Li Changhu saw his wife, his eyebrows softened a lot, and he looked at her and asked softly.
Ren Ping'er had a dignified appearance, with a bit of joy in her eyebrows, and said in a low voice:
————
Unexpectedly, Li Xiangping picked up the bluestone easily and even raised his head and took a few steps back due to excessive force.
"Yes." Li Changhu nodded heavily and hurried to the main courtyard.
"At the end of the fetal life, the life span is one hundred and twenty years. The magic power flows through the orifices. The body is light, the strength is strong, the ears are clear, and the eyesight is clear. The magic is performed by pinching the secrets, which is extraordinary."
"Golden Light Technique"
Bright sparks flashed past, and a medium-deep knife mark appeared on the surface of the bluestone. It retreated a full palm's distance, leaving pale white friction scratches on the ground.
"What did you say?"
Li Mutian thought for a while, his expression softened a lot, he shook his head and said:
"Forget it tomorrow, go prepare for Xiang Ping's wedding. Don't make it too public. Just invite some relatives and keep it low-key."
Li Xiangping made a magic trick and slowly woke up from trance.
Li Xiangping recalled the description in the "Taiyin Tu Na Yang Lun Sutra" and couldn't help laughing, and carried the bluestone into the backyard.
"I can't lie to you anymore. My mother-in-law has seen it, so I have it." Ren Ping'er nodded shyly and said.
"Good spell!"
"What?" Li Changhu was so shocked that the depression and irritation in his mind disappeared. His face turned red and he asked excitedly:
"Really?"
The "Taiyin Breathing and Nourishing Wheel Sutra" could not be read or written, but the accompanying magic formula could be dictated and written down. Li Tongya and several others copied the spells they had obtained and passed them on to each other.
"The screen is here!" Li Changhu said with a smile, as silly as a child.
"Introduction of Qi and practice of Hua, Xuanjing in the ninth month, breathing in and out, and clearness in the third month, it is called the best root and bone." Li Xiangping sat next to his second brother, reciting the description in the Sutra of Nourishing the Wheel, and said to Li Tongya:
"With the help of foreign objects, this Xuanjing's standard can't be considered, but this March Chengming can be borrowed for comparison."
Li Changhu nodded repeatedly, pulled Ren Ping'er to sit down, and carefully greeted her.
"Golden Light Technique" is not difficult. After reading and comparing it for two nights, Li Xiangping understood all the tricks in his heart.
"Father."
The volume of "Golden Light Technique" in front of him is the spell obtained by Li Chijing. Li Xiangping had completed the Xuanjing Wheel a few nights ago, so he borrowed this spell to practice.
"Then you won't practice cultivation?" Li Mutian raised his head and looked at him coldly.
"Father, father! Ping'er is here!"
The six wheels of fetal breath are called Xuanjing, Chengming, Zhouxing, Qingyuan, Yujing, and Lingchu respectively. Among them, the three wheels of Xuanjing, Zhouxing, and Yujing are called the three passes of fetal breath, which are particularly difficult.
"Jing'er entered Xuanjing in less than a month. Although there were Dharma books to help him, he still couldn'tToo amazing. "Li Tongya shook his head.
"Dangqiang..."
Li Changhu laughed and was overjoyed. He quickly shouted and walked towards the backyard.
“Golden Light Technique! "
"good! good. "
He reached out and picked up the wooden slip standing in front of him, loosened the tied cloth strip, and unfolded it with a "clatter".
Unexpectedly, after entering the main courtyard, he saw his wife Ren sitting in the courtyard, sewing clothes and chatting with Tian Yun. The female relatives were not allowed to enter the ancestral hall in the backyard, so they had to wait here.
Li Changhu looked firm and said:
Tian Yun saw Li Changhu coming out and the couple seemed to be talking to each other, so she smiled and made an excuse to go back to Tian's house.
After waving his hand to disperse the spell, Li Xiangping walked out of the courtyard. Several brothers were practicing cross-legged practice. He found a bluestone at the door, hugged it with both hands, and shouted in a low voice:
"Get up! "
"I have it. "
Hearing the sound of iron weapons clashing, Li Mutian immediately put down his knife, hurried to the main courtyard, and asked excitedly:
“If it’s not right, don’t cultivate. "Li Changhu had already prepared a draft. He looked at his father and explained:
"My talent is far inferior to that of Tong Ya and Xiang Ping, let alone Jing'er. I can barely practice with the help of Dharma Jian. During the day, I might as well help my father sort out the family property and go for a walk in the fields, so as not to make people suspicious. "
He straightened the bluestone, stepped back three feet, cast a magic seal, and a golden light jumped out from his palm, slashing straight at the bluestone.
This is a technique for attacking and protecting the way. By pinching the secret and casting the spell, a golden light can be condensed, which is extremely sharp.
Li Chijing and others helped Fa Jian break through the fetal breath gate easily. From then on, there was no shortcut for the Chengming Wheel, so they had to breathe out the spiritual energy and condense the fetal breath.
He turned his left hand, and a radiant golden light emerged from his palm.
But Li Tongya had already woken up from his trance, looked at Li Xiangping and said with a smile:
"This spell is most useful for Jing'er. A few days ago, he cast a spell and chopped off the rockery in the backyard. I didn't even dare to tell my father. "
“Long Lake. "
He held the back of the knife with his right hand, pinched the blade with the thumb and index finger of his left hand, held the knife steadily with both hands, and polished it repeatedly on the sharpening stone.
Under the bright moonlight, the large characters at the beginning of the volume are clearly visible:
This golden light can be attached to the sword to kill the enemy, or it can be thrown out, which is particularly powerful.
"In terms of cultivation, we are really not as good as Jing'er. "Li Xiangping curled his lips, straightened the bluestone, and estimated the mana in his body. He could probably cast the spell four to five times.
Li Mutian laughed heartily, patted the blushing Ren Ping'er, and said loudly to Li Changhu:
"I'll go and ask for it, sir, so you can look at her. "
"What's the matter? "Li Mutian said calmly without raising his head.
"Not bad. "Li Tongya nodded slightly and whispered:
"Brother, he..."
"I'm afraid my eldest brother is even worse than you and me. "Li Xiangping spoke in a somewhat depressed tone, quietly looking at Mount Dali under the night.
"I will adjust my breath for a few more days, and then I can try to condense the Xuanjing Wheel. If I succeed, all the Dharma Jian can be used for my elder brother's practice. "Li Tongya thought.
Li Xiangping, who was looking at Dali Mountain, squinted his eyes, stood up suddenly, looked at the back mountain and said sternly:
"The thief is so brave! "
(End of chapter)
